cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — standing; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — kneeling on the ground; an empty orbital postal-sorting hobby booth with one unlettered cylindrical delivery capsule — she tries her self-designed pneumatic-post attendant costume while checking a homemade spring cushion for a reusable delivery capsule; a quiet library reading room with tall bookshelves — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height; her compact orbital apartment sitting room — even on a day off she notices a picture hanging a few degrees crooked: she holds her tiny homemade bubble level against the top edge while turning one small wall-mount adjustment screw; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a Yangtze ferry landing with moored junks under red sails and coiled ropes on the wooden pier — lying on her front; a Peking opera dressing room — kneeling on the ground; a mossy path under ancient oaks with shafts of light — casts the line with a fishing rod; overgrown jungle temple ruins — standing; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — writes with a calligraphy brush and an ink stone on rice paper laid flat on the table; a quiet library reading room with tall bookshelves — sips a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw through the straw
